description: Source code for the BarrierTaskContext class in Apache Spark, providing contextual tooling for barrier stage tasks including barrier synchronization, allGather, and task info retrieval.

classes.name: BarrierTaskContext
classes.description: A specialized TaskContext for barrier stage tasks, providing barrier synchronization and task info methods.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Returns the current active BarrierTaskContext, accessible inside user functions.

methods.name: barrier
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks in the stage reach this barrier, synchronizing them.

methods.name: allGather
methods.description: Blocks until all tasks reach this point, then gathers messages from all tasks.

methods.name: getTaskInfos
methods.description: Returns info for all tasks in the barrier stage, ordered by partition ID.
